sections.section: Reliable Fidelity and Diversity Metrics for Generative Models (p. 1–9)

omissions.source: It assumes that the embedding space is uniformly dense, relies on the initialisation-sensitive k-means algorithm for support estimation, and produces an infinite number of values as the metric.
For example, ℓ2 distance over the image pixels ‖Xi − Yj‖2 is misleading because two perceptually identical images may have great ℓ2 distances (one-pixel translation)
even human judgement based measures like Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) are not ideal, as practitioners have diverse opinions on what the 'ideal' generative model is
the D&C are computed over randomly-initialised VGG features of dimension 64 (§4.2)
We set X ∼ N(0, I) and Y ∼ N(µ1, I) in R64 where 1 is the vector of ones and I is the identity matrix

distortions.source: Under the R64, the recall and coverage values are in the more sensible range: 0.572 and 0.653, respectively.
distortions.summary: whereas R64 gives 0.58 recall and 0.70 coverage

distortions.source: We assume that the real distribution X is a mixture of Gaussians in R64 with ten modes.
distortions.summary: The left part shows a “Real distribution” as a black four-peaked curve

distortions.source: Coverage, on the other hand, decreases gradually even under the simultaneous dropping. It reliably captures the decrease in diversity in this case.
